title: EFE security log stream (v1.0)
description: Sprint D13. One event per auth/authz check. Source of the dashboard 05_audit_stream auth-failure panels and the D13ObsAuthFailureSpike alert.

event.description: Discriminator. auth_ok is logged at DEBUG by default ; the others at WARN/ERROR.

reason.description: Free-text reason. May contain a scope name (e.g. "missing scope: admin:catalog:write").

claimed_tenant.description: tenant_id sent by the client in the request payload.

actual_tenant.description: tenant_id extracted from the validated JWT. Mismatch with claimed_tenant = security event.

actor.description: For grafana_admin_action events : the human operator's email.

action.description: For grafana_admin_action events : the Grafana action (e.g. dashboard.update).

target.description: For grafana_admin_action events : the target object name (e.g. dashboard UID).

diff_summary.description: For grafana_admin_action events : a human-readable diff (e.g. "panel 3 query changed").
